question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a teal ball, Bob has a silver ball, and Claire has a red ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) teal ball
(B) silver ball
(C) red ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (teal, silver, red)
1. Alice and Claire swap: (red, silver, teal)
2. Bob and Claire swap: (red, teal, silver)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (silver, teal, red)
Alice has the silver ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
